name: Face Wash | Chando Naturals Mint Cool Anti-Microbial Face Wash 100ml Daily Cleanser for Oily and Acne-Prone Skin
description:
Refresh and protect your skin with Chando Naturals Mint Cool Anti-Microbial Face Wash. Specially formulated with natural mint extract and antibacterial agents, it deeply cleanses pores, removes dirt, sweat, excess oil, and bacteria that can cause breakouts. The instant cooling sensation soothes skin and energizes the senses, making it perfect for hot or humid weather. Gentle yet effective, this daily cleanser leaves your face feeling fresh, clean, and protected throughout the day.
Key Features:
 Size: 100ml tube
 Infused with natural mint extract for cooling freshness
 Anti-microbial formula helps fight acne-causing germs
 Deeply cleanses pores without over-drying
 Removes oil, sweat, and impurities effectively
 Suitable for oily, combination, and acne-prone skin
How to Use:
 Wet face with water
 Apply a small amount of face wash and lather
 Massage gently in circular motions
 Rinse thoroughly and pat dry
 Use twice daily for best results
Ingredients:
Mint extract, Aqua, Glycerin, Mild surfactants, Anti-microbial agents
Safety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes; rinse immediately if contact occurs
 Discontinue use if irritation develops
 Keep out of reach of children
Package Includes:
 1 × Chando Naturals Mint Cool Anti-Microbial Face Wash 100ml
